rules.expected: The chosen continuum treatment has reproducible numerical evidence and independent stability checks. Do not require two model narratives.

Search coverage, convergence, regime consistency and local stability are documented. Check the conserved area, admissible radius/regime, numerical minimum and positive local curvature or equivalent local-minimum evidence. A stationary root without stability is not an equilibrium-radius solution; molecular-software job counts are irrelevant.
The computed energy terms explain spontaneous-curvature, bending and interlayer contributions to the selected radius.

The continuum energy calculation yields a stable equilibrium inner radius near 2.69 nm and explains its selection through spontaneous curvature, bending stiffness and interlayer attraction, with regime and numerical-stability checks.
